__comment: PiGallery2, a self-hosted, folder-based photo gallery. No OAuth: the customUI app com.palm.app.pigallery2-auth collects the server's address, the user name and the password, and calls com.palm.service.pigallery2/login, which checks them. PiGallery2 has no tokens, so the password is what the account keeps (as WebDAV's does); a gallery with sign-in turned off keeps none. A PHOTO source only - no DOCUMENTS capability, no files app.
__comment2: com.palm.app.pigallery2-auth MUST be in write/readPermissions: createAccount runs under the customUI auth app's identity and is permission-checked against these lists.
__comment3: com.palm.service.pigallery2 is in readPermissions so the service itself can readCredentials(accountId) for the photo-provider calls. The Photos app is not: it never needs the password.

capabilityProviders.__comment: Makes the PiGallery2 account a photo source. The Photos aggregator (com.palm.service.photos, its service name derived from the templateId) calls com.palm.service.pigallery2/listAlbums+listPhotos: every folder is an album, with the folder it is in as its parentAid (sub-albums). PiGallery2's links need its session, which listPhotos hands over as a Cookie header for that listing's downloads, never the password.
